ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (!ISNEW(), ISPICKVAL(Approval_Status__c, 'Approved By Corporate Head Credit/Retail') , OR (ISCHANGED(Qrm__c), ISCHANGED(RM__c), ISCHANGED (Remarks__c)), OR(NOT(ISPICKVAL (Status__c, 'Deferred')), NOT(ISPICKVAL (Status__c, 'Pending with Quotation Team')), NOT(ISPICKVAL (Status__c, 'Sent to Customer'))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Can only update Status to 'Deferred' if quote is approved.
